title: Six doors say a Space comes with Crew
detail: The six /for doors now carry PLAN_STORY.crewSpace (lib/pricing/plan-story.ts) in the what-does-it-cost answer and the Nonprofit answer, and every door's under-CTA line reads 'No card. A Space comes with Crew, and you pay when you start charging.' Until the beta ends the 'no card' claim stays true. The operator lifecycle emails (Day 0, 1, 3, 7) are not built yet, so the Crew line goes into them when they are.
